events.name: Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix 2026 (first SG Sprint weekend)
events.attendees: 260,000+ over race weekend, large international share
events.rationale: Night race plus Singapore's first F1 Sprint (final Sprint round of the season, Round 17). Padang Stage line-up confirmed complete across 10 stages: CORTIS and JJ Lin (Fri 9 Oct), Zara Larsson and The Killers (Sat 10 Oct), James Arthur then Lana Del Rey closing (Sun 11 Oct), plus Janet Jackson, Mark Ronson and DJ Snake. Grand Prix Season Singapore runs 2-11 Oct citywide. Historically the strongest citywide compression weekend of the year - international adults staying 3-5 nights in/near CBD. Comp scrape for 10 Oct confirms: most comps 2-4x normal ADR (Rest Bugis S$898, Hotel Mono S$704, Nuve S$704, Hotel 1900 S$669), Bliss and Kinn Studios sold out. Dates and line-up re-confirmed unchanged this run (singaporegp.sg).
events.best_fit: All sectors - The Quays and City Hall closest to circuit; Chinatown and Kampong Glam overflow

events.name: TOKEN2049 Singapore
events.rationale: Crypto's largest global gathering, deliberately scheduled into F1 week; back-to-back with the GP it creates a 5-6 night compression block Oct 6-12. Attendees are international adult professionals with strong side-event activity across CBD shophouse districts. Comp scrape for Wed 7 Oct already shows meaningful lift (Kinn Habitat S$507, Nuve S$369, Rest Bugis S$317, Kinn Studios S$749 on last unit).
events.best_fit: Chinatown and The Quays (CBD proximity, side events); City Hall

events.name: SuperReturn Asia 2026
events.rationale: Asia's largest private capital conference; senior international finance delegates staying 3-4 nights in/near CBD with heavy side-meeting activity. Adult business travellers, strong rate tolerance. Comp scrape for Mon 28 Sep re-confirms comps still sitting at plain base rates (Clover 769 S$110, Claude S$124, Quay S$123) with wide availability - a clear pricing opportunity if delegates book late.
events.best_fit: The Quays and City Hall (CBD/finance district adjacency); Chinatown

events.name: F✦FOREVER 1st World Tour (three nights)
events.attendees: ~10,000-12,000 per night across three nights, heavy Greater China and SEA fly-in
events.rationale: NEW THIS RUN and imminent - only 10 days out. Three consecutive Indoor Stadium nights (Fri 14, Sat 15, Sun 16 Aug, all 8pm) as the final Southeast Asian stop of the tour, featuring Jerry Yan, Van Ness Wu and Vic Chou (F4) with Mayday's Ashin. Mandopop legacy act with a 30s-50s adult fanbase - an unusually good match for adults-only shophouse product - and reunion/final-stop shows of this kind reliably pull Taiwan, Malaysia, Indonesia and China fly-in fans staying 2-3 nights. A three-night run is a sustained demand block, not a one-night spike. Comp scrape added for all three dates this run: comps are already firming (The Quay sold out 16 Aug and down to 1 unit on 15 Aug, Kinn Studios 1-2 units on 14-15 Aug, Coliwoo 2-4 units, Clover 769 3-6 units) while several are still priced at ordinary midweek levels (Hotel 1900 S$164-168, Bliss S$163-173, Claude S$171-177) - the clearest near-term pricing opportunity in the file.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang); The Quays

events.name: Post Malone - The BIG ASS Stadium World Tour
events.rationale: CORRECTED THIS RUN: single Singapore show on Fri 25 Sep with Don Toliver supporting, not the two-night run recorded last run. The 27 Sep date belongs to the Kuala Lumpur leg (TM Stadium Nasional), not Singapore - Live Nation SG lists 25 Sep only. Demand remains High because stadium acts of this scale reliably pull SEA fly-in fans who stay overnight and the audience is mostly young adults, but the window is now one night rather than three, so any three-night minimum-stay or shoulder-night pricing built off the previous assumption should be pulled back to a Fri-Sat pattern.
